nom: Rovectin Cica Care Blemish Clearing Cream

avis.texte: I have heard of this brand in passing and saw many rave about how great the products are. I, of course, was skeptical but this item convinced me that it is so worth trying. First, I love the feel of the cream. I have never felt this way about a skincare product but it has a really nice softness thats like a nice silk grazing across my face. I genuinely said out loud the word "wow" when I first tried the item. It provides a good amount of moisture without it feeling super heavy on my skin. I also really liked the packaging and the scooper. I have only seen this really when it comes to cleansing balms but really appreciate the thought put to the design as well as the foresight to include the little spatula.

avis.titre: Moisturizer that lasts all day.Moisturizer that lasts all day.
avis.texte: Pros: This is a non-greasy, quick absorbing, moisturizing product. My face feels absolutely amazing, and my hands do too. When I put it on my hands, I’ve noticed I can wash my hands multiple times, and they still feel good and not dried out. I noticed that my face still feels good. Even 24 hours later. There is a small spoon included, I recommend using that, and then washing it, so that you don’t introduce germs into the whole jar. The expiration date is over 2 1/2 years out from my order date. Cons: No English instructions are included on the jar. FYI: The Amazon product listing does say that there is an item in it that will help with acne, I don’t remember what that is, and it’s not listed on the box. Amazon listing also recommends that you wash your face, then use a toner, then use a serum before applying this product. Since none of that is included in the instructions on the box, I have not bothered with the toner or the serum.

avis.titre: 1st, does no harm & 2nd - it feels good!
avis.texte: I ordered this to try on my upper back area where I get breakouts from gym sweat & spandex clothing. The calamine ingredient caught my eye since that’s the only thing that dried up my numerous bouts with poison ivy when I was a kid! I’ve been using it for almost 2 weeks now & here’s how it’s going: — rinsing off after my workout &/or shower before bed, then applying this to my back. — it’s easy to spread & absorbs fairly quickly. — there’s no discernible strong scent. — after trying to dry out my back area, it feels nice to have it moisturized instead. — I’d say my back is no worse than it was & it actually hasn’t reacted to sweat & fabric like it had been. — I’d prefer to have some written instructions included! There’s info on the listing here, but having some recommendations with the jar in the bathroom is better. Bottom line? If you want to spend more than drugstore prices (2 oz. jar is currently @ $33) for a cream that feels good & may help your skin, this is a decent choice. **Thank you for reading this review & I hope that it’s Helpful!** 😊

For me this wasn't a treatment cream, so much as a cream to use over my treatments that would not cause more problems. It is light enough that it can be worn under makeup but I wasn't able to use it over serums because it would gum up which is a common issue with serums/creams that aren't from the same line. Overall not a bad pick but it's not my absolute favorite. I have mature skin and like thicker creams.

avis.titre: Caused more acne for meCaused more acne for me
avis.texte: I love this product because it makes my skin feel so nice and moisturized. A little goes a long way, which was also really nice. Unfortunately, after 2 days, I noticed a large increase in blackheads. This is the only product I had changed in my routine. I'm not sure why, maybe this product is just not made for my skin type or I used too much. Just be careful and test it on one part of your face at first.

Great plastic, screw on jar with an interior plastic cover. Includes a spatula. This pale pink moisturizer has a gel texture. It is easily absorbed and lightweight. This is great for warmer weather, I really like it! No odd reactions and no strong scent. ROVECTIN Cica Care Blemish Clearing Cream for Acne prone skin to soothe skin irritation and improve oiliness, sebum, and blackheads with Calamine, Centella Asiatica (1.96 fl.oz, 50ml)

avis.titre: Cica cream with calamine = clear skin
avis.texte: This is a really nice cream with a smooth texture. It absorbs fully and doesn't leave my skin feeling sticky. It also doesn't dry out my skin or cause a pulling feeling. I apply this after cleansing my face and follow it with a serum, moisturizer and sunscreen for the top layer.

This is a really nice cica cream. I love using skin care product that contain centella asiatica (cica) because they are usually more gentle while still being very moisturizing. This cream is gentle and soothing and doesn't irritate my skin. I like that it comes with a little scoop so I don't have to put my fingers in the tub every time I use it. It absorbs quickly and makes my skin feel soft and moisturized. I think it's a little expensive for the size of the jar. Most of the writing on the jar is not in English so you'll need to refer to the listing for instructions and ingredient info if you need it down the track.. It's completely unscented and I love that it's vegan and cruelty free too.

avis.titre: Soothing barrier repair cream for sensitive skin
avis.texte: Incorporating this Korean skincare moisturizer into my daily routine has been a fantastic way to keep random breakouts and stubborn redness firmly under control. The calming formula relies heavily on Centella Asiatica and niacinamide, which work beautifully together to strengthen your compromised skin barrier while quickly soothing inflamed patches. I only added a thin layer as applying too much of the rich cream can take an extra moment to fully absorb before you can comfortably move on to your sunscreen or makeup. I noticed that despite its powerful blemish-clearing properties, it never leaves my face feeling tight or stripped of essential moisture, instead providing a very comfortable and deeply hydrating finish. It feels lightweight and the gentle results make it fantastic value for money for maintaining a clear and healthy complexion.

I've been using this cream mainly on areas where my skin gets a bit red or spot prone, and it has been quite gentle so far. The texture is light and smooth, and spreads easily. I usually apply it after cleansing and toner. It absorbs fairly quickly and doesn't leave a greasy or shiny finish, which I prefer. I have sensitive skin and didn't experience any irritation. It's not an overnight fix for blemishes, but after three weeks of daily usage, my skin looks a bit more softer and settled, especially rougher areas like my cheeks. A little goes a long way so it will last a while. Overall, good quality and value. Would happily recommend.

The ROVECTIN Cica Care Blemish Clearing Cream comes in a plastic jar with a small scoop. It is unscented, medium-weight, and easy to apply. The cream takes a little time for the skin to absorb and settle, but doesn't feel heavy. Once settled, the skin feels moisturized, nice to the touch, calm, and smooth. This is a good quality cream.

My daughter is prone to acne and blackheads. She likes this cream but it hasn't rid her of her blackheads. She said it goes on smooth, very moisturizing with no scent. She does like it for a moisturizer.
I like how this cream feels nice and moisturizing on. It absorbed into my skin and didn't leave it looking shiny. You only need a very small amount so this jar will last awhile.
